payload.title: Audit remaining intent and add explicit finish receipts with compact reads
payload.description: Review open requirements against current implementation and retained evidence. Close only fulfilled, answered or replaced requests. Add structured task finish, discussion/work distinction, compact reads and explicit full history; preserve partial backlog and configured verification authority.
acceptance: Audit open acceptance criteria and distinguish partial versus completed work without guessing from similarity or elapsed time.
Explicit finish records answered, implemented, superseded or cancelled outcomes and replacement IDs; configured checks alone establish verified code completion.
Agent and dashboard work views exclude explicitly classified discussions while preserving history and access.
Default CLI get/reconcile and MCP output are bounded and omit event/activity dumps; raw history requires explicit full.
Finish receipts survive hooks and causal merges; ownership, invalid requests and failed verification remain truthful.
